originality.rationale: The target is the global two-input edge-BV Lipschitz modulus of a nonlinear star maximal map, not the single-input variation quotient or vertex ℓp norm. Explicit comparisons with Soria–Tradacete (2014), González-Riquelme–Madrid (2020 and sequel), and González-Riquelme–Kovač–Madrid (2026) find no stated theorem implying the exact 2m/(m+1) positive-input constant plus signed-domain obstruction. Published mathematical-record searches for equivalent formulations, parameter aliases, and the sharp expression produced no covering claim. This is a qualified same-model novelty judgment, not bibliographic proof.

value.rationale: A natural robustness modulus for a widely studied nonlinear maximal smoother is determined sharply for all star sizes. A known single-input BV contraction coexists with a two-input expansion exactly twice as large for m≥2 and asymptotically approaching 2. Explicit attainability and the infinite signed-input boundary distinguish this from routine recomputation of one-input constants.
